title: Bounded list decoder
statement: Given a decoder that reads a Boolean list and may return an element of a type together with the unread remainder, define a recursive decoder with a natural-number fuel bound. Zero fuel and an empty input both fail; a leading false succeeds with the empty list and the remaining input, while a leading true decodes one element and recursively decodes the remainder with one less unit of fuel, failing if either decoding step fails.
